info.title: ColdTrack API
info.description:
API of **ColdTrack Edge**: receives the temperature and humidity telemetry of sensors installed in refrigerated cargo, classifies each reading against the range of the cargo, and serves the web dashboard (login, registrations, queries, assistant).

## Authentication
- **Dashboard**: `POST /login` returns a JWT (8 hours). Send it in `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (**Authorize** button, scheme `bearerAuth`). On every call the API checks the user in the database: a removed user, a changed password, `POST /sair` or a different company invalidate the token, and the current profile is the one that counts.
- **Sensor**: `POST /telemetria` uses the sensor's own key in the `x-device-key` header (scheme `dispositivo`), generated by `POST /dispositivos`.
- **Public**: `POST /empresas`, `POST /login`, `GET /perfis`, `POST /chat`, `GET /health`.

Profiles: `operador` (read), `gestor` (read and register) and `motorista` (only `GET /motorista`, with the vehicle linked to the account, plus its own account: `GET /eu`, `POST /senha`, `POST /sair`; every other dashboard route answers `403`).

## Multi-company
The token carries the company and every query filters by it: each company only sees its own data. An item of another company answers exactly like a missing item (`404`).

## Errors
Always `{"erros": ["message", ...]}`. Field errors are prefixed with the field name (`email: formato inválido`). `204` has no body.

Paths, field names and enum values (for example `operador`, `gestor`, `ATENCAO`) are part of the contract and stay in Portuguese; the error messages returned by the API are also in Portuguese.

## Usage limits
| route | limit |
|---|---|
| `POST /login` | 20 wrong attempts per IP every 15 min (`429`); per account, a wait of 1 to 15 min from the 5th wrong password in a row |
| `POST /chat` | 10 questions per minute per IP; 2000 per day for the whole site (`429`) |
| `POST /assistente` | 15 questions per minute per user; 300 per day per company (`429`) |
| `GET /motorista` | 30 calls per minute per user; the screen polls every 20 s (`429`) |

## Health
`GET /health` returns `200` when the database responds and `503` otherwise.

post.description:
**Who can call:** device (its own key in the `x-device-key` header). The key is valid only for its own `deviceId`.

Validates the reading, classifies it by the range of the cargo profile of the vehicle that uses the sensor (no vehicle: `demonstrativo`) and stores it. A reading is never overwritten; a resend with the same values (including `seq`) returns `200` with `duplicada: true`. When the reading is worse than the previous one of the same sensor (NORMAL to ATENCAO or CRITICO, ATENCAO to CRITICO), the API sends a Web Push to the subscribed operators and managers of the company and to the drivers linked to the vehicle of that sensor (at most one per sensor and range every 10 minutes; readings measured more than 30 minutes ago do not notify). A push failure never changes the answer.

200.description: Resend of a reading already stored with the same values.

201.description: Reading stored; the range goes back so the sensor lights the right LED.

post.summary: Sends a liveness signal without a valid reading
post.description:
**Who can call:** device (its own key in the `x-device-key` header). The key is valid only for its own `deviceId`.

Sent by the board on every cycle (20 s) in which it has no valid reading to send; today the only reason is `sensor_falha` (the DHT read failed). It never creates a reading: an invalid reading is never stored as valid. It updates the device's last contact (so `GET /dispositivos` shows it `online`) and the sensor state: `sensor` becomes `falha`, with `sensorFalhaDesde` kept from the first heartbeat of the failure until a valid reading arrives. The next valid reading (`POST /telemetria`) ends the failure. Heartbeats are not queued offline by the board: an old liveness signal says nothing about now.

Limit: 6 per minute per device (the board sends 3).

200.description: Heartbeat stored; the current sensor state goes back.

delete.summary: Deletes the caller's company and all of its data
delete.description:
**Who can call:** manager (token from the login), and only for the company in the token. Right to erasure (LGPD, art. 18, VI). The body must repeat the company name exactly as registered (or the company code, `empresaId` from `GET /eu`; case and surrounding spaces are ignored) and the manager's current password.

Deletes, in this order: the sessions and push subscriptions of the other users, the sensors (their keys stop working), all readings of the company (including those of sensors removed before), trips, vehicles, the other users, the company and, last, the manager who asked. Every token of the company stops working.

**Idempotent and resumable:** an item already gone is skipped. If a call stops in the middle (failure, or the 120 s work limit answered with `202`), repeating the same call continues where it stopped; while the company record exists the name is accepted, after that only the code. Once the manager is deleted, a repeated call answers `401`.

A wrong password counts toward the same escalating wait as the login. Limit: 5 well-formed calls per manager per hour. The log records only the company code and the counts, with no personal data. Rate-limit counters (hashed, no e-mail or IP in clear) expire by themselves.

200.description: Company deleted. `removidos` counts the documents deleted by this call, per container.

202.description: Work limit reached before the end. What was deleted stays deleted; repeat the same call to continue.

post.summary: Logs in with e-mail and password
post.description:
**Who can call:** public (no authentication). Returns a JWT valid for 8 hours.

The `401` is identical, in message and in timing, for an unknown e-mail, a wrong password and an account on hold. From the 5th wrong password in a row the account is put on hold (1, 2, 4, 8 and at most 15 min). A single IP with 20 wrong attempts in 15 min receives `429`. When the user has 2FA active, the right password returns `{ "exige2fa": true, "desafio": "..." }` instead of the token; finish with `POST /login/2fa`.

post.description: **Who can call:** operator, manager or driver (token from the login). No body. Raises the session version: every token already issued (all devices) starts receiving `401`. Also removes the user's push subscriptions.

post.summary: Starts 2FA activation: generates TOTP secret and QR code URI
post.description: **Who can call:** authenticated user (token from the login). Returns the `otpauth://` URI to scan with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.). The secret is stored temporarily; call `POST /2fa/ativar` with the first 6-digit code to activate. If 2FA is already active (new phone), the new secret is kept in a provisional field and the current one keeps working until `POST /2fa/ativar` confirms the new one.

200.description: TOTP secret and QR code URI.

post.summary: Activates 2FA: validates the first TOTP code and stores secret + recovery codes
post.description: **Who can call:** authenticated user (token from the login). Requires a pending 2FA activation (from `POST /2fa/iniciar`). Body: `{ "codigo": "123456" }`. On success returns 10 recovery codes (8 lowercase alphanumeric chars each). Store them safely; each works once and is then invalidated.

post.summary: 2nd step of login: validates challenge JWT + TOTP code or recovery code
post.description: **Who can call:** public (no authentication). Called after `POST /login` returns `{ "exige2fa": true, "desafio": "..." }` when the user has 2FA active. Body: `{ "desafio": "...", "codigo": "123456" }` or `{ "desafio": "...", "recuperacao": "abc12345" }`. The challenge JWT expires in 5 minutes. On success returns the same token structure as `POST /login`. Wrong, expired or already used code, missing or expired challenge: `401` with the same message. A TOTP code is accepted once (the accepted time step is stored and the write is conditional on the document's etag); a recovery code is removed from the list when used. Limits: 10 wrong attempts per IP and 5 per account every 5 minutes (`429`).

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired challenge; wrong, expired or reused TOTP code; unknown or used recovery code; user without 2FA, removed or on hold.

get.summary: Latest readings of a company sensor
get.description: **Who can call:** operator or manager (token from the login). From the most recent measurement to the oldest. A sensor of another company answers exactly like a missing sensor (`404`). Without the `status` filter, `lacunas` lists the gaps in the sequence numbers of the returned readings (lost readings); gaps are computed by number, not by measurement order: a reading that arrives out of order is not a gap, and a number present in the response is never reported missing; a number lower than the lowest of the current count (in measurement order) is a counter reset and starts a new count.

parameters.name: limite
parameters.description: Maximum quantity; a value outside 1 to 500 is adjusted to the limit.

parameters.name: horas
parameters.description: Only readings measured in the last N hours.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Accepted statuses, separated by comma (NORMAL, ATENCAO, CRITICO).

parameters.name: antes
parameters.description: Pagination cursor (ISO 8601): only readings measured before it. Pass the `proximo` value of the previous page.

proximo.description: Cursor for the next (older) page: pass it as `antes`. Null when there are no more readings.

get.summary: Probability of outdoor temperature above 30 °C for a departure month and hour
get.description: **Who can call:** operator or manager (token from the login). Climatological model trained on the hourly data of the INMET automatic station A307 (Petrolina), training years 2019–2022 and test years 2023–2025 (temporal split). The answer includes the naive baseline and both Brier scores, so the user can compare. **Limitation:** the model describes the typical outdoor climate, not the forecast of the day, and it does not use the readings of the cargo sensor. It supports a human decision (departure time, reinforced monitoring) and never triggers an automatic action. Model card: `docs/model-card.md`.

parameters.name: hora
parameters.description: Hour of the departure, Brasília time (0 to 23).

200.description: Probability, risk level, baseline and model version.

modelo.fonte: INMET, estação automática A307 (Petrolina), dados horários

get.summary: Sensor temperature forecast 10 minutes ahead, with the persistence baseline
get.description: **Who can call:** operator or manager (choose the sensor with `deviceId`, which must belong to the company of the token) or driver (always the sensor of the vehicle linked to the driver; `deviceId` is ignored). A sensor of another company answers like a missing one (404). Uses the last readings of the sensor itself: a ridge regression (no intercept) on the change over the last 5 and 10 minutes and the 10-minute mean, trained and evaluated with a temporal split on the real readings of the team's board (`analise/sensor/modelo_previsao.py`). The answer always carries the persistence baseline and both test errors; `recomendada` says which one won on the test split, and the screen should show that one. **Limitation:** few hours of data, sensor on a bench and not inside a refrigerated box; with the current data the model does **not** beat the baseline (see `modelo.superaBaseline`). It supports a human decision and never triggers an automatic action. Model card: `docs/model-card.md`.

parameters.description: Sensor of the user's company. Required for operator and manager; ignored for the driver.

200.description: Forecast, baseline, recommended source and model version. `previsao` and `baseline` are null when `motivo` explains why.

get.summary: Checks whether the API and the database are responding
get.description:
**Who can call:** public (no authentication).

Returns `200` when the database responds and `503` when it does not. The response carries no internal details.

get.summary: Returns the VAPID public key for push alerts
get.description: **Who can call:** public (no authentication). The dashboard needs this key to subscribe the browser. Returns `503` while the API has no VAPID keys configured.

post.summary: Subscribes this device to push alerts
post.description: **Who can call:** operator, manager or driver (token from the login). Stores the subscription in the user's document (field `push`, at most 10 devices; the oldest leaves). The same endpoint is never duplicated, and if it belonged to another account (shared device) it is removed from there. The user then receives a push whenever a sensor gets worse (NORMAL to ATENCAO or CRITICO, ATENCAO to CRITICO): operators and managers for every sensor of the company, with the tap opening `/alertas?veiculo=<id>`; a driver only for the sensor of the vehicle linked to them (field `veiculo` of the user, read again at each reading), with the tap opening `/motorista`. A driver without a linked vehicle receives nothing.

201.description: Subscribed. Returns how many devices the user has.

400.description: Invalid body or unknown push service.

erros: endpoint: serviço de push não reconhecido

delete.summary: Removes this device from push alerts
delete.description: **Who can call:** operator, manager or driver (token from the login). Removes the subscription with this endpoint from the user. Idempotent: an endpoint the user does not have also answers `204`. `POST /sair` also removes every subscription of the user.

204.description: Removed (or was not there). No body.

Erro.description: Single error format. Field errors are prefixed with the field name (`email: formato inválido`).

Faixa.description: Normal temperature range (°C). Up to `margem` °C outside it is ATENCAO; beyond that, CRITICO. A null `min` means no lower limit.

Perfil.description: Cargo profile and its temperature range (°C).

veiculo.description: Only for the `motorista` profile: code of the company vehicle linked to the driver (uppercase).

totpAtivo.description: Whether the user has 2FA (TOTP) active. The settings screen shows "Activate" or "Deactivate" from it.

veiculo.description: Only for the `motorista` profile: code of the company vehicle linked to the driver (uppercase).

token.description: HS256 JWT valid for 8 hours. Use it in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

uri.description: otpauth:// URI to scan with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.)

codigo.description: 6-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app

items.description: Recovery code (8 lowercase alphanumeric chars). Each works once.

confirmacao.description: Company name exactly as registered, or the company code (`empresaId`). Case and surrounding spaces are ignored.

removidos.description: Documents deleted by this call, per container (`dispositivos`, `leituras`, `viagens`, `veiculos`, `usuarios`, `empresas`).

veiculo.description: Only for a `motorista` user: vehicle of the company fleet.

Telemetria.description: Reading sent by the sensor. Booleans do not count as numbers, NaN is rejected and an unexpected field is an error.

temperaturaBruta.description: Optional. Temperature read by the sensor before the board's median filter (`temperatura` is the filtered value). Stored with the reading for audit only; status and alerts use `temperatura`.

umidadeBruta.description: Optional. Humidity before the board's median filter, stored for audit only.

rssi.description: Wi-Fi signal (dBm). The key is required; `null` when the radio returns an impossible value.

medidoEm.description: Optional. UTC epoch in seconds of the measurement: up to 5 min in the future and up to 7 days in the past. Without it, the time of receipt is used.

origem.description: Optional. Where the reading came from: the physical board (`placa`) or the Wokwi simulator (`simulador`). Without it (older firmware) the reading is stored as `nao_informada`. Any other value is rejected with 400.

seq.description: Optional. Sequence number of the reading, kept by the sensor in flash: it grows by 1 per reading and survives a reboot, so a gap means a lost reading. Older firmware without it is still accepted. A resend must repeat the same `seq`.

motivo.description: Why there is no reading to send.

rssi.description: Wi-Fi signal in dBm; `null` when the radio gives an impossible value (simulator).

seq.description: Sequence number of the last reading the board produced (the heartbeat does not use a number of its own).
Sequence number sent by the sensor. Absent for readings of firmware without it.

origem.description: Where the reading came from: physical board, Wokwi simulator, or `nao_informada` (older firmware or reading stored before the field existed).

ultimoContato.description: When the sensor's latest contact arrived: a reading or a heartbeat, whichever is newer; null if it never sent anything.

online.description: True if the latest contact (reading or heartbeat) arrived at most 120 s ago.

sensor.description: Last known state of the temperature sensor: `falha` when the latest contact was a heartbeat with reason `sensor_falha` (no valid reading since), `ok` when it was a valid reading, `null` when the board never sent anything. Read it together with `online`: `online` true and `falha` means a live board with a failed sensor; `online` false means no contact at all.

sensorFalhaDesde.description: When the current sensor failure started (first heartbeat of it); `null` unless `sensor` is `falha`.

chave.description: Sensor key, shown only now (the database keeps the SHA-256). It goes in the `x-device-key` header.

id.description: Code of 3 to 20 letters, digits or hyphens (converted to uppercase). In PUT the route id is used.

deviceId.description: Sensor registered in the company and not used by another vehicle.

ViagemEntrada.description: In POST the id is generated (`V-` + 6 characters); in PUT the route id is used.

veiculo.description: Vehicle code registered in the company.

fim.description: Optional; ISO 8601 with time zone, after `inicio`.

historico.description: Optional: earlier messages of the conversation.

fontes.description: Documents used as context, without repetition.

example.resposta: A manga fica normal entre 10 °C e 13 °C...

hora.description: Hour of the day, Brasília time.

probabilidade.description: Model probability that the outdoor temperature exceeds the threshold at that month and hour.

nivel.description: Risk level: `baixo` up to 0.20, `moderado` up to 0.50, `alto` above 0.50 (same 50% cut used in the evaluation).

horasDeHistorico.description: Training hours behind this month and hour cell (sample size).

baseline.description: Naive baseline for comparison: the overall share of hours above the threshold in the training years, the same for every month and hour.

nivel.description: Risk level: `baixo` up to 0.20, `moderado` up to 0.50, `alto` above 0.50 (same 50% cut used in the evaluation).

anosTeste.description: Later years, never seen in training (temporal split).

brierModelo.description: Brier score of the model on the test years (lower is better).

brierBaseline.description: Brier score of the naive baseline on the same test years.

usaLeiturasDoSensor.description: Always false: the model uses public weather station data, not the cargo sensor readings.

LacunaSequencia.description: Readings missing between two received ones, by sequence number.

chave.description: VAPID public key (base64url, uncompressed P-256 point). The browser passes it as applicationServerKey to pushManager.subscribe().

PushInscricao.description: The browser's PushSubscription.toJSON(). expirationTime and other fields are accepted and ignored.

endpoint.description: https URL of a known push service: fcm.googleapis.com, *.push.services.mozilla.com, *.push.apple.com or *.notify.windows.com. Any other host is refused (the API never posts to arbitrary URLs).

PainelMotorista.description: What the driver screen shows: only the vehicle linked to the driver.

historico.description: Readings of the last hour, oldest first (at most 180), for the mini chart and the trip alerts on the driver screen. Empty when the vehicle has no sensor.

leitura.description: Last reading of the vehicle sensor; `null` when the sensor never sent one.

status.description: Status of the last reading, or `SEM_LEITURA` when there is no reading or the last one was measured more than 5 minutes ago (the sensor sends every 20 s).

minutosSemLeitura.description: Whole minutes since the last reading was measured; `null` without reading.

viagem.description: Trip in progress (started, and without end or with the end in the future); `null` when there is none.

sensor.description: Last known state of the temperature sensor: `falha` when the latest contact was a heartbeat with reason `sensor_falha` (no valid reading since), `ok` when it was a valid reading, `null` when the board never sent anything. Read it together with `online`: `online` true and `falha` means a live board with a failed sensor; `online` false means no contact at all.

sensorFalhaDesde.description: When the current sensor failure started (first heartbeat of it); `null` unless `sensor` is `falha`.

perfil.description: Cargo profile stored with the reading.

para.description: Instant the forecast refers to: last reading time plus horizonteMin.

status.description: Status of the forecast temperature in the cargo profile of the last reading.

previsao.description: Model forecast (ridge regression on the sensor's own recent readings). Null when there is no basis (see motivo).

para.description: Instant the forecast refers to: last reading time plus horizonteMin.

status.description: Status of the forecast temperature in the cargo profile of the last reading.

baseline.description: Persistence baseline: the last reading repeated. Null when there is no recent reading.

recomendada.description: Which forecast won on the temporal test split (lower MAE). The screen should show this one.

antecipaExcursao.description: True when the recommended forecast has a worse status than the last reading (the cargo is expected to leave the range).

motivo.description: Why a forecast is missing: no readings, last reading older than the gap limit (5 min), or less than janelaMin minutes of continuous history (model only).

amostras.description: One sample per minute of continuous readings.
One sample per minute of continuous readings.

maeModelo.description: Mean absolute error on the test split, °C.

superaBaseline.description: True only if the model MAE is lower than the baseline MAE on the test split.

exige2fa.description: The password was accepted, but the user has 2FA active: no token yet.

desafio.description: Challenge JWT (5 min) to send to `POST /login/2fa`. It is not an access token: the other routes reject it with `401`.

NaoAutenticado.description: No token, invalid or expired token, or session ended.

SemPerfil.description: Account without profile or without company.

erros: seu perfil não tem acesso a esta ação

SemPermissao.description: The user's profile cannot perform this action (operador on a manager route; motorista on any route other than its own account and `GET /motorista`).

CorpoInvalido.description: Invalid body or field outside the rule.

caso2.summary: corpo deve ser um objeto JSON

NaoEncontrado.description: Does not exist or belongs to another company (both answer the same).
